content: {"summary":"学生代码完整提供，静态可见表头校验、逐行有效性判断、分钟未知/已知分类及已知分钟累加。未发现外部IO或空结果返回缺失；按固定任务逐项评审。","overall":"pass","criteria":[{"criterion_id":"C01","verdict":"pass","reason":"使用csv.DictReader读取后检查fieldnames，缺失必需列或表头不存在时抛出ValueError，满足缺表头抛错要求。","evidence_span":"if reader.fieldnames is None or not required.issubset(reader.fieldnames):","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C02","verdict":"pass","reason":"使用csv模块解析带引号CSV；逐行校验record_id可转int且>0，分钟空白视为未知，非空须int且0至1440，非法行计入invalid_count并跳过，符合行有效性约束。","evidence_span":"if rid <= 0 or (duration is not None and not 0 <= duration <= 1440):","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C03","verdict":"pass","reason":"有效行先计入record_count；分钟为None时计入missing_duration_count，否则计入known_duration_count，已知0分钟走else分支，未把0当缺失，也未把未知当已知。","evidence_span":"duration = None if raw == \"\" else int(raw)","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C04","verdict":"pass","reason":"仅在分钟已知分支将duration累加进known_minutes，未知分钟不参与累加，已知0分钟累加0，未发现覆盖、重置、漏加或重复累加有效非零分钟。","evidence_span":"out[\"known_minutes\"] += duration","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C05","verdict":"pass","reason":"返回字典在循环前初始化五个计数字段为整数0，即使没有有效行也返回完整五字段。","evidence_span":"out = {\"record_count\": 0, \"known_duration_count\": 0, \"known_minutes\": 0,","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C06","verdict":"pass","reason":"函数仅使用csv和io处理传入字符串，不读写文件、不联网、不执行任意代码，符合纯函数与静态边界要求。","evidence_span":"reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_text))","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null}]}
